title: China Reached 500 Nuclear Warheads As The World Cut Back
hook: China reached 500 nuclear warheads while the world total kept falling.
closing: A reversal in nuclear disarmament makes every country's security harder to predict.
question: Can the decline resume?

segments.say: The world once held 70,300 nuclear warheads; treaties then pushed the total sharply downward.
China reached 500 nuclear warheads, reversing the expectation that every major arsenal was shrinking.
Russia holds 5,580 nuclear warheads, showing established powers still dominate the balance.
